## Why visit

One of the strongest reasons to leave central Manchester for Stockport. The Magnet combines a serious changing cask range with the sociability of a multi-room local: you can compare styles, settle into a quieter corner or talk beer at the bar. Keg and continental bottles broaden the possibilities without displacing cask as the main attraction. The viaduct setting and terraces add local character, although November makes the indoor rooms more relevant. It pairs naturally with the Crown and Petersgate Tap, but deserves enough time to explore more than one beer style.

## Beer

The pub advertises fourteen cask lines plus changing keg and international bottles; numbers describe capacity/normal offering, not a guarantee of availability. CAMRA names Salopian Oracle as a regular cask and RedWillow and Track among changing suppliers; a recent sighting included Bathams Best Bitter.

## Food

Pork pies and snacks; official site advertises evening pizza on Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Verify the November schedule.

## Plan the visit

Official weekday opening starts later than weekend opening. Do not make this an assumed Monday lunchtime stop.

**Getting there:** North of Stockport centre on the A6; combine with the Crown before or after the old-town pubs.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
